messages:
sam: Planning a config-only deploy in tonight's 21:45 PT change window. Cfg id cfg-7643210000. Changes: tinybatch.window, routing.priorities, background timeout floor. Canary: 5% for 15m across us/eu then ramp.

deploy-bot: Scheduled by sam — canary 5% for 15m. Targets: 3 hosts us-west, 2 hosts eu-west. Rollout id cfg-7643210000. Obs: https://dash/reports/cfg-7643210000

rachel: Ack. I'll run smoke: 25 synths/region, check 5xx, 99p, kv-cache misses. Pause if 5xx > 0.4% or 99p > 750ms.

lee: Recommend model.pin=v1.4-rc to avoid kv-cache layout mismatch and enable sticky routing for VIP tenants.

sam: Applied: model.pin=v1.4-rc, routing.sticky=vip, tinybatch.window 55ms -> 30ms, timeout.background 16s -> 12s.

deploy-bot: Canary started (5%). To pause: `/deploybot pause cfg-7643210000`. To rollback: `/deploybot rollback cfg-7643210000`. Logs: `kubectl -n infra logs -f deploy/cfg-7643210000`

devops-bot: Alert: eu-west 99p latency rose to 910ms at +6m. KV-cache miss rate increased for tenant-eu-research.

rachel: Throttling canary to 2% and pausing rollforward. Log: `WARN kvcache.prewarm: miss_ratio=0.33 tenant=tenant-eu-research`.

lee: Suggest partial rollback of tinybatch.window and routing.priorities, keep model.pin. Proposed: `/deploybot rollback cfg-7643210000 --targets tinybatch,routing --reason "eu kv miss spike"`

sam: Executing partial rollback now. Notifying CS about a short EU latency blip. Scheduling kv prewarm and slower ramp for retry.

deploy-bot: Partial rollback completed at 7643210042. Canary halted. Rollback summary: tinybatch.window restored to 55ms, routing.sticky reverted, model.pin retained (v1.4-rc). Next: run kv prewarm job, validate 99p for 10m, then re-run canary with stepwise bump.
